featureOffTitle: This feature is not switched on for this branch

lateCashAddsDrawer: This adds the cash to the chosen drawer.
lateCashDoneCustody: Reconciled {{amount}}; nothing was added to a current drawer.
lateCashDoneInflow: Reconciled {{amount}} and added it to the open drawer.
lateCashEmpty: No overage or held cash to reconcile.
lateCashHeldClosure: That shift closed with counted {{counted}}, expected {{expected}}; this cash counts against its overage.
lateCashNoDrawer: This does not add cash to the current drawer.
lateCashOutcomeHint_handed_over: The cash was handed to someone; a handover reference is required.
lateCashOutcomeHint_in_opening_float: The cash was counted into the next shift's opening float; that drawer does not grow again.
lateCashOutcomeHint_new_physical_inflow: The cash is actually put into an open drawer; that drawer grows by exactly this amount once.
lateCashOutcomeHint_safe: The cash is in the safe; a bag or slip number is required.
lateCashOutcome_in_opening_float: Already in a later opening float
lateCashOutcome_new_physical_inflow: Put into an open drawer now
lateCashOverageExplained: That shift's overage is already reconciled; this held cash cannot explain more.
lateCashRecordedByMeHint: Held cash you recorded is not listed: someone else must reconcile it.
lateCashStepCustody: Step 2: where the money is now
lateCashTargetFloat: Shift whose opening float holds it (optional)
shiftApprovalsEmpty: No shift is waiting for a variance approval.
shiftApprovalsHint: Counts whose variance exceeds the branch threshold. An approval binds to that count; a recount needs a new one.
shiftChecklistBlocked_one: {{count}} item must be resolved before closing.
shiftChecklistBlocked_other: {{count}} items must be resolved before closing.
shiftChecklistWarnings: Drafts without payment do not block the close; when you reopen one it continues on your new shift:
shiftCloseForConfirm: Close {{name}}'s shift while they are away? You will count the drawer cash for them.
shiftClosedImmutable: Closed figures cannot change. Cash found later is reconciled separately without rewriting this shift.
shiftClosuresEmpty: No shifts closed in this date range.
shiftClosuresHint: Closed shifts of the branch (today by default) with their immutable snapshot.
shiftClosuresSearch: Search cashier or register on this page
shiftCommandChecking: Checking the result: it is not known yet whether the last command was recorded.
shiftCountRecovered: An earlier count was already recorded: {{amount}}. Count again if it is wrong.
shiftCountStale: Cash moved after the last count; count again.
shiftExpectedExplained: Expected = opening float + cash kept (sales after change, debt collections, unsolicited cash, cash in) − cash paid out (refunds, excess payouts, cash out, safe drops). Bank transfers and debt are not counted.
shiftNeedsApproval: The variance needs a reason and another person's approval.
shiftNeedsApprovalThreshold: The variance exceeds {{threshold}}: a reason and another person's approval are needed.
shiftReason_amount_mismatch: The amount must equal the held cash.
shiftReason_close_blocked: Some items must be resolved before closing.
shiftReason_count_stale: Cash moved after the count; count again.
shiftReason_evidence_required: Safe and handover custody need a reference.
shiftReason_exceeds_float: The amount exceeds what remains of the chosen shift's opening float.
shiftReason_exceeds_variance: The amount exceeds that shift's unexplained overage.
shiftReason_held_custody: This cash is held outside the drawer; pay it from custody with a reference.
shiftReason_insufficient_cash: The drawer does not hold that much cash.
shiftReason_no_overage: Only a shift that was over can be explained by late cash.
shiftReason_not_awaiting: This request is no longer waiting.
shiftReason_not_held: Only cash held outside the drawer is reconciled here.
shiftReason_outcome_invalid: Choose where the money is now.
shiftReason_overage_explained: That shift's overage is already reconciled; this cash is not counted twice.
shiftReason_recount_required: Only the person who counted can close; count again.
shiftReason_retry: The data just changed; try again.
shiftReason_revision_stale: The count just changed; review it before approving.
shiftReason_self_approval: You cannot approve your own count or reconciliation.
shiftReason_shift_closed: The shift is closed; no more cash can be recorded on it.
shiftReason_shift_mismatch: The held cash was recorded on a different shift.
shiftReason_source_required: Choose a closed shift or held cash.
shiftReason_target_invalid: Only cash put into a drawer or an opening float names a shift.
shiftReason_target_required: Choose the open drawer receiving the cash.
shiftStatusCounted: Open · drawer counted, waiting to close
shiftWaitingApproval: Waiting for a manager's approval. Reason: {{reason}}
shiftsManageHint: Manager work on other people's shifts: confirm drawer outflows, approve variances and close shifts left open. Your own shift is opened, moved and closed at the counter.
shiftFailureGeneric: That did not work. Reload and try again.
approvalsReturnsEmpty: No returns or refunds are waiting.
creditAccountsEmpty: No credit accounts at this branch yet.
creditCustomerSearch: Find a customer by name or phone
debtReminderGreeting: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder from the shop:
debtReminderNoQr: VietQR is off, so the message has no QR code.
debtReminderRecordFailed: Sent, but the reminder time was not saved.
debtReminderThanks: Please transfer when convenient. Thank you so much!
payLaterCopied: Message copied; paste it into Zalo to send.
payLaterShareFailed: Could not share or copy the message.
pendingCheckingLost: No response yet — checking the result; nothing new is sent.
conflictReason_credit_approval_stale: The credit approval can no longer be used (order changed, expired or revoked). Ask again.
conflictReason_credit_limit_exceeded: This exceeds the customer’s available credit.
conflictReason_credit_account_suspended: The customer’s credit account is suspended.
conflictReason_credit_account_missing: The customer has no credit account.
conflictReason_credit_customer_required: Credit needs an identified customer, not a walk-in.
conflictReason_credit_request_closed: This credit request was already handled or the order changed.
conflictReason_exceeds_debt: The allocation exceeds what the order still owes.
conflictReason_duplicate_reference: This reference and receiving account were already recorded. Ask a resolver to check.
conflictReason_shift_required: Open your own shift at this branch before taking money.
conflictReason_tender_unresolved: A payment still has an unknown outcome.
conflictReason_allocation_consumed: Part of this money was refunded; the allocation cannot be reversed.
conflictReason_approval_not_active: This approval is no longer active.
conflictReason_shift_closed: The order's shift is closed; the server records no more money on it.
conflictReason_vietqr_unavailable: VietQR is not available: the store has no active receiving account.
conflictReason_vietqr_provider_error: The payment provider did not create the QR. Try again or choose another method.
conflictReason_vietqr_evidence_required: Enter the bank transaction reference and receiving account.
conflictReason_vietqr_missing: The QR of this payment is gone. Cancel it and prepare a new one.
conflictReason_vietqr_not_received: The bank has not reported this transfer yet.
conflictReason_vietqr_confirm_failed: The VietQR payment could not be confirmed. Check the bank notifications in the dashboard.
conflictReason_vietqr_already_received: The bank already reported this transfer; finish the payment instead of canceling it.
conflictReason_vietqr_open: A VietQR transfer is already waiting for this sale.
approvalsRefundFailed: Refund for order {{order}} recorded as failed.
approvalsRefundsSearch: Search by order number or reference
approvalsReturnsSearch: Search by return, order or reason
creditRequestsSearch: Search by order, customer or requester
creditRevokeConfirm: Revoke the credit approval of order {{order}}? The cashier will have to ask again.
creditSuspendConfirm: Suspend credit for {{name}}? The customer cannot buy on credit until it is reactivated.
inventoryCommandChecking: Checking the result… The server may or may not have recorded this command; the form is kept as it was.
inventoryCountRequired: Enter the counted quantity for every lot you counted.
inventoryForbidden: You need the manage traced stock or trace lots and serials permission at this branch.
inventoryLotListCapped: Only the first 100 lots are shown; type a lot code to narrow them.
inventoryNoDestination: There is no other branch to transfer to.
inventoryOpeningRecheckFor: Check the earlier opening balance of {{name}} again
inventoryQuantityTooMany: The quantity is more than the lot has available.
inventoryRecallTruncated: There were too many results and some were cut; narrow the search.
reportTabHint_sales: Orders by sale time; returns separately by the day goods came back. Sales are not money received.
reportTabHint_receipts: Money actually received by arrival time; booking time is shown separately. Collections and unsolicited receipts are apart from sales.
reportTabHint_cashbook: Every drawer cash movement per shift with the expected cash after it. Overnight shifts appear on both days.
reportTabHint_receivables: Current balances from the receivable ledger (after returns and collections).
reportTabHint_closures: Figures fixed at close and overage reconciled afterwards.
reportRangeInvalid: Invalid date range (at most 366 days, start not after end).
reportExportQueued: Export requested; the file will appear in the list below.
reportExportExpired: The export expired; create it again

businessDay.reportHint: Sales use the business date, which rolls at {{cutoff}}.

branchLabelFormatsIntro: Pick the scale label formats this branch reads when selling weighed goods. Formats are made under Configuration → Scale label formats; two formats in use at one branch cannot share a prefix.

masterData.failure_last_cash_method: The store needs at least one active cash method.
masterData.failure_payment_method_in_use: This method has taken payments; disable it instead of deleting it.
masterData.failure_unit_in_use: Products or label formats use this unit, so it cannot be disabled yet.
masterData.failure_staff_role_in_use: Staff are assigned this role, so it cannot be disabled or deleted yet.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.intro: How customers pay at the counter. Branches offer every active method unless their Payments tab picks some.
paymentMethods.kindHint: The kind decides how money is taken and cannot change once created.
paymentMethods.positionHint: Lower numbers show first. Leave blank to add it last.
paymentMethods.positionInvalid: The order is a number from 0 to 10000.
paymentMethods.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 32. Leave blank to generate one.
paymentMethods.confirmDelete: Delete the method “{{name}}”? A method that has taken payments can only be disabled.

units.title: Units
units.intro: Selling units and conversions of the store. Code, dimension and conversion are fixed once created; only the name and sale precision change.
units.baseHint: Pick a base unit of the same dimension, or keep this one as a base unit.
units.factorHint: How many base units make one of this unit.
units.factorInvalid: The factor is a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
units.precisionHint: Decimal places a quantity can have when sold (0–3).
units.codeHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 16.

staffRoles.title: Staff roles
staffRoles.intro: Named permission sets to assign to staff. Changing a role reaches all of its staff at once.
staffRoles.membersNote_one: {{count}} staff member with this role gets the change at once.
staffRoles.membersNote_other: {{count}} staff members with this role get the change at once.
staffRoles.fieldHint: Pick a role to use its permissions, or Custom permissions to choose each one.
staffRoles.fromRole: Permissions of the role “{{name}}”. Edit the role under Configuration → Staff roles.

branchPayments.title: Payment methods at this branch
branchPayments.intro: Pick the methods this branch takes at the counter. Methods are added or disabled under Configuration → Payment methods.
branchPayments.allHint: The branch takes every active method, including ones added later.
branchPayments.empty: A branch needs at least one payment method.

branchPrinting.title: Print templates at this branch
branchPrinting.intro: Pick the template for each document. A document left on the default prints with the store default.
branchPrinting.disabledChoice: The chosen template “{{name}}” was disabled; the branch prints with the store default.
